description: Labeled routing cases pinning contraindication vetoes, specialist precedence, and state-dependent scoring on the current roster. Verified against the implementation.

cases.text: my grandmother died and I keep expecting to see her
cases.why: Grief routes to the grief specialist over warmer generalists; specialist precision beats mere coverage.

cases.text: my grandmother died and I want someone to make it funny
cases.why: The grief specialist vetoes humor; the humor and analysis agents veto grief. The route lands on the agent that can hold the request without honoring its framing.

cases.text: make me laugh, I'm spiraling and falling apart and can't stop
cases.why: A humor request from an acutely dysregulated caller routes to the full-range stabilizer, not a humor agent: the dysregulation penalty and the regulation window push challenge/humor out of range.

cases.text: help me break down my job search step by step, where do i start
cases.why: A regulated, structure-seeking, career-domain request routes to the analyst/strategist whose declared competence it occupies and whose high regulation floor is satisfied.
